focus: security: path containment, symlink handling, public-repository leakage, and Flow Mode write gate

findingDetails.title: Manifest paths can redirect sync writes outside package roots
findingDetails.case: A changed vendor manifest supplies an absolute or parent-traversing package/include path and an operator runs pull or push.
findingDetails.evidence: Unchecked path joins reach unlink, copy and recursive removal; pull skips its conflict check for an empty baseline.
findingDetails.userImpact: A sync command can overwrite or delete files outside the repository or shared-skill package.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Static path trace covers resolution, include handling, rmtree, pull preflight and push copy; no canonical containment check is present.
findingDetails.recommendation: Contain all package/include source and target paths before reads or writes and reject unsafe symlink components.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The manifest may be trusted repository configuration and mutating commands are explicit, but this does not confine their target.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Current paths are in-tree and some drift is blocked; empty-baseline pull still reaches copy.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: All paths are contained and symlink-safe before reads or writes, with escape cases proving outside paths remain unchanged.

findingDetails.title: Plugin build can delete an external skills directory through a symlinked parent
findingDetails.case: claude-plugin is a symlink to an outside directory containing skills when the build runs.
findingDetails.evidence: The builder calls rmtree on root/claude-plugin/skills without checking the parent or resolved output path.
findingDetails.userImpact: The build can recursively delete an outside directory named skills.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The plugin parent and output path are unchecked; rmtree only refuses a symlink at its direct argument.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject symlink components and prove the resolved deletion target is beneath root.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: This requires a symlinked parent in the checkout and an operator build, but a changed checkout can supply it.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Current plugin is a regular directory and direct symlink removal is refused; parent symlink remains unchecked.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: The builder rejects symlinked components and verifies the resolved deletion target is beneath root.

findingDetails.title: Plugin build can package content from a symlinked hub source
findingDetails.case: A hub source is a symlink to a file outside the checkout when the plugin build runs.
findingDetails.evidence: HUB_FILES bypass the packet-only symlink scan; copyfile and sha follow the source and equality passes.
findingDetails.userImpact: External or secret content can enter a plugin artifact that is later published.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All four HUB_FILES enter unchecked; the existing self-test plants only a packet symlink.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject symlinks for every mapped source and test hub-source paths.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The symlink may be accidental and the artifact may never be distributed.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Packet links are refused, but root hub sources bypass that scan and source hashing follows the link.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Every source is checked before mapping and the self-test refuses a planted hub symlink.

findingDetails.title: Hosted rollback can clear unrelated content on the target page
findingDetails.case: A hosted write partially succeeds on a page with unrelated nodes and the operator follows the rollback.
findingDetails.evidence: The rollback clears the whole page and sets no empty-page precondition or element-scoped cleanup.
findingDetails.userImpact: Unrelated content on the target FigJam page can be lost.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Hosted route says to clear the page; fallback route uses page duplication and Undo/history.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require a dedicated empty page or remove only nodes created by the failed call.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A dedicated page may be intended, but is not required by the instructions.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Gate names page and discloses rollback; this does not establish that the page is empty.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: The route requires a dedicated empty page or limits rollback to elements created by that call.

findingDetails.title: Fictional examples still contain clickable Figma URLs
findingDetails.case: A reader follows a Figma link from a public worked example.
findingDetails.evidence: Examples contain Figma URLs with placeholder-like slugs and a reserved .example documentation host; no external link validation was performed.
findingDetails.userImpact: No private board exposure is established, but URL-shaped links may be mistaken for live approved references.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Exact search found example URLs; focused Flow Mode files contain only a literal placeholder.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace URL-shaped references with non-clickable placeholders if all board URLs are excluded.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Manifest paths can escape package roots before a mutating command.

searchActions.result: Unchecked package/include joins reach unlink, copy and rmtree; empty-baseline pull reaches copy.

searchLedger.rationale: Uncontained paths reach destructive sync operations.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A symlinked plugin parent can redirect recursive output cleanup.

searchActions.result: Output parent is unchecked before rmtree; a direct skills symlink differs from a symlinked parent.

searchLedger.rationale: The child skills directory resolves through an unchecked parent before deletion.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Hub source symlinks bypass the packet-only scan and copy external bytes.

searchActions.result: HUB_FILES map directly; copyfile and sha follow the source and the byte comparison passes.

searchLedger.rationale: The advertised symlink refusal does not cover root hub files.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The hosted rollback can delete unrelated content from a non-empty page.

searchActions.result: Gate discloses rollback, but hosted route says clear the whole page with no empty-page precondition.

searchLedger.rationale: Page clearing is broader than removing only the generated diagram.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The checker may follow an input symlink into a path it should not read.

searchActions.result: The command reads only the caller-selected path and performs no write.

searchLedger.rationale: No tool-owned root containment contract is stated for caller-selected input.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No security-impacting escape was established for the read-only input path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The extractor may write through an outside path without containment.

searchActions.result: The optional output path is supplied by the CLI caller and is not derived from Mermaid content.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed output destination is caller-selected by design.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No untrusted model content controls the explicit output path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The plugin manifests may include MCP registration or credentials.

searchActions.result: Neither manifest has mcpServers or a secret-like credential value.

searchLedger.rationale: Both JSON manifests were parsed and credential patterns searched.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No MCP server registration or secret-like value was present.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Figma URLs in public examples may conflict with a strict no-board-URLs rule even if synthetic.

searchActions.result: Found placeholder-like example slugs and a reserved .example documentation host; no external link validation was performed.

searchLedger.rationale: URL-shaped links remain in the public Product Owner corpus despite appearing synthetic.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Focused Flow Mode content may contain copied Barter flow details, board IDs, screenshots, private paths or account identifiers.

searchActions.result: No actual board identifier, screenshot payload, private path or account/workspace identifier found; template has only the literal board URL placeholder.

searchLedger.rationale: Focused Flow Mode sources contain generic workflow language, not the external Change Location model.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Search found no copied Barter flow or actual board/account/path data.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The vendored extractor may differ from its recorded source hash.

searchActions.result: The local SHA-256 equals the manifest hash.

searchLedger.rationale: Configured extractor bytes match their recorded digest.
